# Shakeri Lab

> University of Virginia research lab working at the intersection of machine learning, control systems, dynamical systems, and biomedical applications.

## Primary pages

- Lab website: https://shakeri-lab.github.io/
- Free deep learning course: https://shakeri-lab.github.io/dl-course-site/
- GitHub organization: https://github.com/Shakeri-Lab
- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=zFIIhGMAAAAJ

## Research software

- Dengue Control Scheduler (Aedes Control): https://shakeri-lab.github.io/dengue-control-scheduler/
  Browser interface for comparing mosquito-control schedules using temperature-driven relative dengue transmission risk.
- Source code and desktop application: https://github.com/Shakeri-Lab/dengue-control-scheduler
- Accompanying paper, Optimal scheduling of dengue vector control: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jtbi.2026.112617

## Recent accepted papers

Both papers below were accepted to the ML4H 2026 Proceedings track for poster presentation; proceedings are forthcoming.

- The Stationarity Bias in Continuous Glucose Monitoring Imputation: The Linear-Interpolation Consensus Holds Only in Stationary Regimes: https://openreview.net/forum?id=Bm0lVGTHz2
- From Prediction to Practice: A Task-Aware Evaluation Framework for Blood Glucose Forecasting: https://openreview.net/forum?id=FTwYL20mPf

## Research areas

- Learning-based control and artificial pancreas systems
- Deep learning and foundation models for physiological time series
- Generative modeling of complex dynamical systems
- Operator-theoretic machine learning
